changes.summary: Require a loopback Host and reject any Origin header; health remains unauthenticated but Host-checked.
Bearer tokens are accepted only in Authorization; URL/query tokens are not accepted and the token is not written to stderr/access logs.
Reports externally_writable=true, isolation=none and not_a_sandbox=true for the user's workspace.
Repository source and trace text is untrusted data; content_policy states no repository-instruction execution and no network/write access.
default-src 'none'; the SVG fallback script uses a nonce, not unsafe-inline; no remote assets.
